title: fix: convert Windows selection timestamps to QPC ticks
body:
Fixes triple click selectoin on windows. Selection press timestamps are provided in nanoseconds, but `std.time.Instant` uses QPC ticks on windows. Converting between the units preserves the elapsed time to calculate presses correctly. Exposed while adding windows runner for the libghostty [binding](https://github.com/elias8/libghostty/actions/runs/29901534786/job/88863392044?pr=112#step:10:510).

_Note: used GPT 5.5 to identify the issue._
